name: Subspace — Filter Active-Hiring Companies for Outbound

nodes.name: Sample Domain List
nodes.notes: Replace this Code node with whatever produces your domain list — a Google Sheets read, a Clay webhook, an Apollo export, an HTTP request, etc. Each item must have a `domain` field.

nodes.name: Subspace — Enrich
nodes.notes: Subspace runs once per input item, automatically. 60 req/min during beta — chain a Wait node before this if your list is large.

nodes.name: Active Hiring + 5+ Jobs
nodes.notes:
Filters: actively hiring AND total_jobs >= 5.

Common alternatives (all real fields):
- operating_status == 'active' (DNS resolves + signals)
- confidence == 'high' (high-evidence enrichment only)
- has_compliance_program == true (SOC2 / HIPAA / trust center)
- has_enterprise_sso == true (Okta / Azure AD detected)
- cdn_enterprise == true (enterprise infrastructure)
- recent_funding == true (funding signal in last filings)
- is_spending_on_ads == true (active demand-gen)

Combine with AND/OR by adding more conditions in this IF node.
